QF.id: Cat III AIF Due Diligence and Risk_11

question.text: For Cat III AIF due diligence at the Fund Manager level:

answer.text: Investment process, team stability, compliance record, prior fund performance, fit-and-proper status

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 51 (investment-manager obligations) and pages 257-260 (DD factors) cover investment strategy and process review, investment-management team experience across research, trade execution, sales, compliance and fund administration, manager selection, past performance, disciplinary history, and fit-and-proper status. The Trap: Narrow criteria (only education, age, or rank) are incomplete relative to the source-listed DD factors. Note: The source framing covers process, team experience, prior performance, disciplinary/regulatory history, and fit-and-proper status; specific formal reference-check practices are not stated on the checked pages.
